lines.text: During the time of King Herod, Magi from the east arrived in Jerusalem asking where the King of the Jews was.
Herod was disturbed and asked the chief priests and scribes where the Christ was to be born, and they said Bethlehem in Egypt.
Herod secretly learned from the Magi the exact time the star appeared and sent them to Bethlehem to search for the Child.
The star stood over the place where the Child was, and the Magi worshiped Him and gave Him gold, frankincense and myrrh.
Warned in a dream not to return to Pilate, the Magi went back to their country by another route.
